scope: 6 CALIBRATION cases (writer e004) from the completed v3-vs-v4 A/B: four that BOTH models downgraded under BOTH prompts, and two that one model upgraded under grade-v4. Blinded: model output is withheld until each decision is saved.
instructions: Decide ONE of A/B/C/D from the rubric, official solution and the student's text. Model outputs are hidden until you save. Nothing is relabelled automatically.
warning: Model predictions are shown only AFTER your decision, as context. They are NOT evidence about the label: models agreeing can equally mean models are wrong in the same direction.

options.A: derived verdict is consistent with the rubric and instructor practice
options.B: instructor practice is more lenient than the literal encoded rubric
options.C: transcription/evidence/rubric artifact is incomplete or incorrect

note_guidance.B: say what correct idea the instructor appears to have credited

interpretation_rules.B: keep the authoritative instructor label for alignment metrics; record a rubric-to-practice mismatch; do NOT tune grade-v4 on this case
interpretation_rules.C: mark the previous model comparison for that case invalid until the artifact is repaired
interpretation_rules.D: exclude from strict accuracy metrics or require explicit adjudication
